**Carried items (the bridge scene, ~8.5–10 s)**
- **Missile drawn through the bridge** (`bonus/Missile.java`): a missile waiting on a car was always drawn in the topmost layer. **Shadows**
- **Shadows not turning** (`utils/BodyRegionDrawer.java`): shadows for the missile, mines, bonus spots and obstacles were given an angle in radians where degrees were expected. So they didn't rotate with their object, which was visible on the fired missile. They now turn with what casts them.
- **Car shadow falling the wrong way** (`racer/VehicleRenderer.java`): the car's shadow fell up and to the left, while every other shadow in the game falls down and to the right. It now falls down and to the right like the rest.

- **Showing more road behind the car**: the camera's look-ahead used a mirrored angle, so on some headings it moved behind the car instead of in front. It now always moves ahead in the direction the car is travelling.
- **Speed limit on camera movement**: the code computed this limit but applied it only after the camera had already moved, so it had no effect. It now takes effect. In normal driving the limit is well above how fast the camera moves, so it should only smooth out sudden jumps, but it is the one change that could alter the view slightly. I also removed a duplicate zoom-limit call, which changed nothing.

I didn't touch the track layout or how the vehicles move.
